title: 第3章 今日我带刀前来何须请帖第4章 我今日前来是为了剑宗名额
lines: 黑虫山脉。
森林当中。
萧诺毫不费力的连斩三人。
“真是好刀……”
萧诺看着手中的黑色魔刀，脸上露出了几分触动之色，有实力的感觉真好。
“此刀乃是暗夜妖后的龙鳞所化，那就称呼你为‘暗星魂’吧！”
旋即，萧诺收起魔刀，随后从萧乙三人的尸体中搜出了六枚灵气丹以及一部名为《狼形刀法》的武学。
灵气丹是提升修为所用，乃是一种较为常见的下品丹药。
而《狼形刀法》则是萧家的上乘武学，只有族内的高层弟子有资格修炼。
“萧永才给了这点好处，就让你们三个人来杀我，看来在他的眼里，我的确是一文不值……”
萧诺略带自嘲的笑了声。
六枚灵气丹和《狼形刀法》虽然价值不低，但比起天罡剑宗给萧家的好处，这点东西，连九牛一毛都算不上。
想起萧家的所作所为，想起萧永的心狠手辣，萧诺的眼神分外尖锐。
如果不是自己无意中开启了神坛，得到了鸿蒙金塔，今天自己真的就要饮恨在这荒郊野外了。
如今自己有了鸿蒙金塔，又得到了宇宙四大炼体神诀之首的《鸿蒙霸体诀》，这相当于重来一世，必定要踏上巅峰。
“萧永，三天后你不是要正式拜入天罡剑宗吗？我不会让你……得偿所愿。”
萧诺收刀于身后，眼神坚决，踏步离开。
晰月城！
车水马龙，繁华热闹。
晰月城内共有五大家族，这五大家族，几乎是垄断了城中百分之九十以上的财富。
原本萧家是垫底的，后来和天罡剑宗攀上了关系，短短几年内，一跃成为了前三的家族，甚至用不了几年，便可成为五大家族之首。
萧诺回到了住处，位于偏僻地段的一栋小屋。
萧家的崛起是踩着萧诺的“尸体”
上去的，但萧家的繁华，却没有分他一丝一毫。
萧诺是一个人住，他没有太多关于生母的记忆。
至于父亲，在他被夺走‘天凰血’的半年前，因事离开了家族，至今未归。
夜晚。
万籁俱寂。
萧诺坐在房间的练功台上，闭上眼睛，脑海中开始翻阅着脑海中的《鸿蒙霸体决》修炼之法。
第一层名为“青铜古体”
，一经炼成，肉身强度堪比青铜钢铁，刀剑难入，水火不侵。
哪怕是轻轻一拳，足以砸断对手的骨骼筋脉。
不过很快，萧诺就睁开了眼睛。
“虽然是《鸿蒙霸体决》的第一层，但需要的修行条件极为苛刻，若想炼就‘青铜古体’，还要庞大的资源灵能进行淬体，我现在的这副身躯力量太弱了，而且缺少炼体资源，只怕很难达成‘青铜古体’的要求……”
content_en:
Black Worm Mountains.
In the forest.
Xiao Nuo effortlessly killed three people in a row.
"What a great knife..."
Xiao Nuo looked at the black magic knife in his hand, and his face showed a touch of touch. It felt good to have strength.
"This sword is transformed from the dragon scales of the Dark Night Demon Queen, so let's call you 'Dark Star Soul'!"
Immediately, Xiao Nuo put away the magic sword, and then found six spiritual energy pills and a martial arts called "Wolf Shaped Sword Technique" from the bodies of Xiao Yi and the other three.
Spiritual Qi Pill is used to improve cultivation, and is a relatively common low-grade pill.
The "Wolf Shaped Sword Technique" is the superior martial arts of the Xiao family, and only high-level disciples within the clan are qualified to practice it.
"Xiao Yongcai gave you this little benefit and asked you three to kill me. It seems that in his eyes, I am indeed worthless..."
Xiao Nuo laughed slightly self-deprecatingly.
Although the six spiritual energy pills and the "Wolf Shaped Sword Technique" are of high value, compared to the benefits that the Tiangang Sword Sect has given to the Xiao family, these things are not even a drop in the bucket.
Thinking of what the Xiao family had done, and of Xiao Yong's ruthlessness, Xiao Nuo's eyes were particularly sharp.
If he hadn't accidentally opened the altar and obtained the Hongmeng Golden Pagoda, he would really have been miserable in this wilderness today.
Now that he has the Hongmeng Golden Pagoda and the "Hongmeng Hegemonic Body Technique", which is the first of the four major body refining techniques in the universe, this is equivalent to rebirth, and he will definitely reach the top.
"Xiao Yong, don't you want to officially join the Tiangang Sword Sect in three days? I won't let you... get what you want."
"Wow!"
Xiao Nuo put the knife behind him, with firm eyes, and stepped away.
…
Xiyue City!
Busy and lively.
There are five major families in Xiyue City, and these five major families almost monopolize more than 90% of the wealth in the city.
Originally, the Xiao family was at the bottom, but later it developed a relationship with the Tiangang Sword Sect. In just a few years, it became one of the top three families, and even within a few years, it could become the head of the five major families.
Xiao Nuo returned to his residence, a small house in a remote area.
The rise of the Xiao family is based on the "corpse" of Xiao Nuo
He went up, but the prosperity of the Xiao family did not affect him at all.
Xiao Nuo lives alone, and he doesn't have much memory of his biological mother.
As for his father, he left the family for some reason half a year before he was taken away from the 'Heavenly Phoenix Blood', and has not returned yet.
…
night.
Everything was silent.
Xiao Nuo sat on the training table in the room, closed his eyes, and began to read through the training methods of "Hongmeng Ba Ti Jue" in his mind.
The first layer is called "Ancient Bronze Body"
, once refined, the physical strength is comparable to bronze and steel, it is difficult for swords to penetrate, and it is impervious to water and fire.
Even a light punch is enough to break the opponent's bones and veins.
But soon, Xiao Nuo opened his eyes.
"Although it is the first level of the "Hongmeng Hegemon Body Art", the training conditions required are extremely demanding. If you want to refine the 'Ancient Bronze Body', you will need huge resources of spiritual energy to temper the body. My current body is too weak and lacks body refining resources. I am afraid it will be difficult to achieve the requirements of the 'Ancient Bronze Body'..."
title_en: Chapter 3: Why do I need an invitation when I come today with a sword? Chapter 4: I come today for the quota of Sword Sect
